title: Issue #46: Native Top Layer, Container Queries, and Microtask Overhead
summary: Weekly curation of browser engine changes with direct impact on frontend architecture.

entries.title: Popover API reaches Baseline Widely Available
entries.editorial_take: Native Top Layer promotion and light-dismiss handling render custom React tooltip portals and z-index ladders obsolete.

entries.title: Container Size and Style Queries: the end of ResizeObserver layout hacks
entries.editorial_take: Evaluating container dimensions inside the CSS engine eliminates main-thread ResizeObserver loops and hydration layout flashes.

entries.title: scheduler.yield() available to break up long tasks (INP)
entries.editorial_take: Yields control back to the main thread without losing scheduling priority to third-party timers, directly lowering input latency.

entries.title: Back/Forward Cache (bfcache): diagnosing common blockers
entries.editorial_take: Legacy unload listeners and open IndexedDB transactions prevent browsers from snapshotting pages in memory for instant back/forward navigation.

entries.title: Fetch Priority (fetchpriority='high') on LCP hero images
entries.editorial_take: Signals the browser preload scanner to promote the hero image ahead of deferred scripts during initial HTML tokenization.
